title: Incident Foresight brieflet and alert decomposition prototype
creator: Aisha Natarajan
description:
Problem: responders get flooded with alerts that lack concise context: why the alert fired, which services and routes are implicated, expected cost impact of remediation actions, and which rollout/rollback actions are safe to execute. Goal: design a compact, inline "foresight" brieflet attached to alerts in the Console that decomposes signal causes, surfaces correlated SLO deltas, and offers verified remediation action affordances (runbook links, safe rollback, model/route pinning) without overwhelming on-call flow.

Scope: this ticket prototypes three variants of a brieflet component: (A) linear timeline + causal graph, (B) prioritized checklist with quick actions and cost delta preview, (C) condensed micro-brief with one-click runbook and postmortem link. We include integration points with Rollouts and Cost views so responders can preview estimated token/compute delta when toggling a rollback or model-variant swap.

Design constraints and trade-offs: prioritize readability under stress (large text contrast, minimal scrolling), keep primary CTA (ack/resolve/assign) prominent, and ensure no destructive rollout actions are available without two-step confirmation. To minimize engineering surface, first-pass will only show cost deltas computed by the existing billing API (not on-the-fly simulations).

Success metrics: reduce mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) by 15% in prototype testing vs baseline, reduce number of follow-up triage comments, and increase number of incidents with postmortem link within 48h.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes three visual variants (timeline, checklist, micro-brief) implemented in Figma with clickable flows
Brieflet shows correlated SLO change and historical snapshot (last 60m versus baseline) for up to 3 related services
Cost delta preview displayed for each suggested action (in estimated $/hour and token estimate)
Runbook links, postmortem creation shortcut, and safe rollback affordance present with confirmation modal mockups
Usability test session (n=6 on-call engineers) synthesized and at least one variant scores >= 80% on clarity metric
comments: 2026-02-13 - Aisha Natarajan: Initial design exploration uploaded to Figma. Included early causal-graph idea; needs tighter visual hierarchy.
2026-02-18 - Marcus Lee (Design Review): Favored Variant B for fast triage; asked Eng for feasibility notes on showing cost delta per-action (see ENG question below).
2026-02-20 - Priya Kumar (SRE): Concern about adding runbook CTAs inline — requested audit of read-only links and that we avoid auto-executing actions without 2FA confirmation.
2026-02-24 - Engineering comment (ENG-4820): Quick feasibility: cost delta can be read from billing API with typical 200ms latency; per-action simulation requires backend work (tracked in ENG-4999).

2026-03-01 - Usability testing: 6 participants (mix of on-call engs). Key feedback: testers liked checklist ordering by likely-cause confidence; micro-brief preferred for mobile/tablet. Two testers asked for a one-tap postmortem creation with template attachment.
2026-03-04 - Marcus Lee: Updated Figma with revised micro-brief and added a low-fidelity confirmation flow for rollbacks. Requesting PM review for product policy on automated rollbacks.
2026-03-05 - Emily Soto (PM): Approved moving Variant B to a design handoff with ENG-4999 and ENG-4820 dependencies; flagged legal for potential audit trail changes.
decisions: Keep three visual variants for testing; roll forward with Variant B (Prioritized Checklist) for initial engineering handoff
Cost delta will be read-only values fetched from billing API — no inline simulations in MVP
Rollback and destructive actions will require explicit two-step confirmation and optional SSO challenge
Include an automatic 'create postmortem' shortcut that pre-fills incident metadata and attaches the alert brieflet snapshot
next_steps: Finalize accessibility pass (contrast, keyboard nav, screen reader labels) — owner: accessibility team
Design handoff package (tokens, spacing, assets) and handoff meeting with ENG-4820 and ENG-4999
Add PM task to update runbook link governance and audit requirements
Schedule 2-week prototype A/B remote usability run with 12 participants (target org-wide on-call lists)
